title: A new gate flow read a per-replica license cache right after an Anchor write and failed by replica luck
service: echopoint flow suite (`echopoint: invitation email budget`), Anchor SDK license cache
summary: `echopoint: invitation email budget` was added to the `echopoint` gate tag at about 18:00Z after three green runs and one green suite run. At 19:41:34Z, in the post-deploy gate for echopoint#733, its node `usage-lowered` read `limit 20` 79 ms after the flow PATCHed the license to 5 on Anchor. Echopoint reads licenses through the Anchor SDK cache (30 s TTL per replica) and the PATCH bypasses Echopoint, so a replica that served the previous read answers stale data. The earlier green runs passed because the two reads landed on different replicas. The flow now polls the limit through a module and makes that poll its final check; it ran green three times.

impact.text: Dev and CI only. The flake was one of the two checks that failed the echopoint gate for echopoint#733, so it would have held prod promotion on its own.

numbers.label: between the PATCH and the stale read
Anchor SDK license cache TTL per replica
dev Echopoint replicas, each with its own cache

trigger: Gate run 41705330775: `usage-beta` (19:41:33.914Z) and `usage-lowered` (19:41:34.135Z) both landed on `echopoint-dev_echopoint.1`, around the Anchor PATCH at 19:41:34.056Z (VictoriaLogs).
detection: The echopoint-investigation routine read the red gate at 00:08Z. The gate's Discord alert at 19:42Z had no owner (see the companion SEV4 on gate flows that pinned old behaviour). Detection was adequate for a flake: the gate failed closed. The missing piece is an owner for red gates, covered by the companion postmortem's action.
resolution: New module `license: invitation limit poll (module)` polls `GET /license/usage` until the limit equals the expected value (2 s interval, 60 s timeout); the flow ends on that poll. A first version that polled and then read once more failed 3 of 3 runs: the poll was answered by the fresh replica and the next read by the stale one.

events.label: Deploy-failure alert to Discord, no owner
Inline poll fails: a poll body cannot read node outputs
Poll then read: 3/3 red, proves per-replica caches

whys.problem: The echopoint post-deploy gate failed on a new flow, which alone would have held prod promotion

because.text: `usage-lowered` read limit 20 from a replica that had cached the license 220 ms earlier
because.evidence: VictoriaLogs: both GETs on `echopoint.1`; PATCH on Anchor between them

because.text: Echopoint reads licenses through the Anchor SDK cache, 30 s per replica, and the flow wrote the license on Anchor directly
The flow guide covers projections that lag a write, not read caches in front of another service
Four earlier green runs hid the race: the two reads usually landed on different replicas
because.evidence: A version with one extra request in between failed 3/3 at 00:17Z (parity shifted)

because.text: The routine's acceptance rule is three serial green runs, written for count races in one process
because.evidence: Run notes: 'run any new or reshaped flow 3x before trusting it' (2026-10-05 count race)

because.text: Repeated serial runs do not vary replica placement, so they cannot prove a check free of per-replica state
A flow three runs old sat in a gate that holds the whole product's promotion
The routine tags a flow into the gate as soon as it passes alone; the gate runs it beside 46 others
because.evidence: Run notes coverage entry: green 3x + in the suite, tagged the same run

because.text: New flows join the gate tag with no soak period in the concurrent suite

contributing: The same gate also failed on a flow that pinned behaviour echopoint#733 changed on purpose, so the promotion was held either way.

well: VictoriaLogs task names showed the replica of each request, which made the cause provable in one query.
wrong: The first fix (poll, then read) passed review in my head and failed every run.
lucky: The flake fired in the same gate as a real failure, so it held nothing extra; next time it can hold a clean deploy.

actions.what: Poll the limit in a module and end the flow on that poll
flow-suite-testing skill: a read behind a per-replica cache after a write that bypasses it is polled, and the poll is the final check
New flows run in the full concurrent tag twice before they are tagged into a gate
Invalidate the Echopoint license cache on Anchor `organization.license.updated`, if Echopoint receives that event
Routine reads every Deploy Router gate result each run and runs a red flow through this loop

messaging.internal: The invitation email budget flow failed the echopoint gate on a 30 s license cache; it now polls. No product bug.
